items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Oh yeah, I know him, yeah. Me was in the, me was in the St. Battalion. I was the company, I was the company A, five, five, 15 years old. Ernest was company B, St. Battalion.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know him, yeah. Me was in the, me was in the St. Battalion. I was the company, I was the company A, five, five, 15 years old. Ernest was company B, St. Battalion. Ernest, Ernest showed me a lot of people traveling on to the trance.
Did he play in New Orleans?

items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: And Ernst and I could play trombone, play trumpet, play trombone too.

ctx.x: Yeah. on his hands, came on with the band, was a good position. And William Foster, you know, all the people, you know. And William Foster said, Bob, you called me Bob, he said, he said, let's come and get the band with us, with the lines. And they brought all them boys, put them on nice, put them shoes, rustling shoes, tanned shoes, they brought them heavy shoes, with them nails on. William said, I can help you. And he said, yeah, Bob. And so they talked to Lieutenant Lyons, I said, Lord have mercy that morning.…
